test.create_query: CREATE TABLE facts (id UInt64, slice UInt8, val UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dim (g UInt64, bucket UInt8) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY g
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO facts SELECT number, number % 16, number FROM numbers({table_size})
INSERT INTO dim SELECT number, number % 16 FROM numbers({dim_size})
test.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT count() AS c0 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 0) AS s0, (SELECT count() AS c1 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 1) AS s1, (SELECT count() AS c2 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 2) AS s2, (SELECT count() AS c3 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 3) AS s3, (SELECT count() AS c4 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 4) AS s4, (SELECT count() AS c5 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 5) AS s5, (SELECT count() AS c6 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 6) AS s6, (SELECT count() AS c7 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 7) AS s7

SELECT * FROM (SELECT count() AS c0 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 0) AS s0, (SELECT count() AS c1 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 1) AS s1, (SELECT count() AS c2 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 2) AS s2, (SELECT count() AS c3 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 3) AS s3, (SELECT count() AS c4 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 4) AS s4, (SELECT count() AS c5 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 5) AS s5, (SELECT count() AS c6 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 6) AS s6, (SELECT count() AS c7 FROM facts WHERE val > 0 AND slice = 7) AS s7 SETTINGS optimize_fuse_sibling_aggregate_subqueries = 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT count() AS c0 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 0) AS s0, (SELECT count() AS c1 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 1) AS s1, (SELECT count() AS c2 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 2) AS s2, (SELECT count() AS c3 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 3) AS s3, (SELECT count() AS c4 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 4) AS s4, (SELECT count() AS c5 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 5) AS s5, (SELECT count() AS c6 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 6) AS s6, (SELECT count() AS c7 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 7) AS s7

SELECT * FROM (SELECT count() AS c0 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 0) AS s0, (SELECT count() AS c1 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 1) AS s1, (SELECT count() AS c2 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 2) AS s2, (SELECT count() AS c3 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 3) AS s3, (SELECT count() AS c4 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 4) AS s4, (SELECT count() AS c5 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 5) AS s5, (SELECT count() AS c6 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 6) AS s6, (SELECT count() AS c7 FROM facts, dim WHERE facts.id = dim.g AND dim.bucket = 7) AS s7 SETTINGS optimize_fuse_sibling_aggregate_subqueries = 1
